title: Oil Fried Croatian Pickle Fried Rice
description: A savory and crunchy Croatian dish featuring dill pickles, perfect for a solo dinner, vegan-friendly and made in a wok.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped dill pickles and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the cooked rice to the wok, stirring to combine with the pickle mixture.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Remove the wok from the heat and serve the Oil Fried Croatian Pickle Fried Rice hot.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
